children: Quality Industrial announced two material agreements to realign consideration tied to its Middle East platform. The company signed a $2.0 million Share Exchange Agreement with Fusion Fuel Green, under which Fusion Fuel will issue 500,000 Class A ordinary shares to three Al Shola Gas investors, while Quality Industrial will issue $2.0 million of its common stock to Fusion Fuel based on a market price formula. Separately, an amendment to the Al Shola Gas purchase agreement reschedules the $10.0 million purchase price through 2027, allows payment in cash or listed securities, imposes lock-up and leak-out limits, removes prior financing obligations, and adds a call option and dividend framework. These actions are intended to align stakeholders, provide flexibility, and support regional growth.
